description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger You begin a ranged Strike with a firearm.

Hot Loading is baseline for every Ironsight and its cost is stated in §4: it widens your Failure Range by 1 for that shot. This feat makes you better at it rather than granting it. Your Hot Loads deal a second additional die of the weapon's damage type, and once per round you may Hot Load without widening your Failure Range at all — that one was seated properly.
